defaults.source: Distilled from [docs.shopware.com](https://docs.shopware.com/de/shopware-6-de) (German merchant documentation), retrieved 2026-08-20. Operating the administration, not developing against it — for code, use the `shopware-*` developer plugins.

catalog.title: Shopware catalogue administration
catalog.description: Operating the Shopware catalogue: products, variants, categories, properties, manufacturers, media, product streams, reviews. Use when the request is about the Shopware admin under Kataloge.
catalog.intro: Everything under **Kataloge** in the Shopware administration. Product creation with its mandatory fields, variant generation, advanced prices, SEO and cross-selling.

orders.title: Shopware order administration
orders.description: Operating Shopware orders: order list, creating and editing orders, state machine transitions, documents, refunds. Use when the request is about the Shopware admin under Bestellungen.
orders.intro: Everything under **Bestellungen**. An order's three state machines — order, payment, delivery — and the documents and refunds that hang off them.

customers.title: Shopware customer administration
customers.description: Operating Shopware customers: accounts, addresses, customer groups, bulk edits, B2B customers, storefront account view. Use when the request is about the Shopware admin under Kunden.
customers.intro: Everything under **Kunden**, plus what the customer sees in their storefront account.

content.title: Shopware content administration
content.description: Operating Shopware content: Shopping Experiences, CMS blocks and elements, themes, media manager. Use when the request is about the Shopware admin under Inhalte or Erlebniswelten.
content.intro: Everything under **Inhalte** — Shopping Experiences (Erlebniswelten), themes and the media manager.

marketing.title: Shopware marketing administration
marketing.description: Operating Shopware marketing: promotions, discount codes, newsletter, the rule builder for marketing rules. Use when the request is about the Shopware admin under Marketing or Aktionen.
marketing.intro: Everything under **Marketing** — promotions and their conditions, discount codes, and the newsletter.

settings.title: Shopware settings administration
settings.description: Operating Shopware settings: shop basics, taxes, currencies, payment and shipping methods, rule and flow builder, mail templates. Use when the request is about Shopware Einstellungen.
settings.intro: Everything under **Einstellungen** — the largest area of the administration, from shop basics to the rule and flow builders.

sales.title: Shopware sales channel administration
sales.description: Operating Shopware sales channels: creating channels, domains, product assignment, API access, comparison feeds. Use when the request names a Shopware Verkaufskanal or sales channel.
sales.intro: Creating and configuring sales channels: domains, currencies, payment and shipping assignment, API access, comparison feeds and social shopping.

commercial.title: Shopware Commercial features
commercial.description: Operating Shopware Commercial features: B2B suite, subscriptions, custom pricing, returns, multi-inventory, advanced search. Use when the request names a Shopware Commercial or Evolve feature.
commercial.intro: Paid features from the Commercial extension. Each entry notes the plan and minimum version it needs — check that before promising a feature.
commercial.notes: Availability is plan-bound: Rise, Evolve and Beyond differ, and several features carry a minimum Shopware version.

services.title: Shopware Services
services.description: Operating Shopware Services: AI copilot, image editor, 3D preview, Nexus, Intelligence Plus. Use when the request names a Shopware Service or Shopware Payments.
services.intro: Cloud services booked on top of a Shopware installation, billed and enabled separately from Commercial features.

cloud.title: Shopware Cloud (SaaS)
cloud.description: Operating Shopware Cloud: SaaS setup, tenant administration, what differs from a self-hosted shop. Use when the request names Shopware Cloud or SaaS.
cloud.intro: Setting up and running a Shopware Cloud tenant, and the limits that distinguish it from self-hosted.

update.title: Shopware updates
update.description: Updating a Shopware shop: running the update, version specifics, staging environments, pre-update checks. Use when the request is about updating or upgrading a Shopware shop.
update.intro: Planning and running a Shopware update: the pre-flight checks, the staging rehearsal, and what changes per version.

migration.title: Shopware migration
migration.description: Migrating to Shopware: the migration process, data mapping, going live. Use when the request is about migrating a shop to Shopware or the Migration Assistant.
migration.intro: Moving an existing shop to Shopware: what the Migration Assistant transfers, and the go-live sequence.

spatial.title: Shopware Spatial Commerce
spatial.description: Operating Shopware Spatial Commerce: 3D products, AR, the scene editor, immersive elements. Use when the request names Shopware Spatial, 3D products or AR.
spatial.intro: 3D and augmented-reality product presentation: model requirements, the scene editor and immersive CMS elements.

insider.title: Shopware insider previews
insider.description: Shopware insider previews: bundles, the new scene editor, features not yet generally available. Use when the request names a Shopware insider preview or an unreleased feature.
insider.intro: Features in preview. Treat everything here as subject to change — behaviour and UI can differ from the released product.

tutorials.title: Shopware how-to guides
tutorials.description: Shopware how-to guides: worked examples, multilingual shops, EU regulations, troubleshooting recipes. Use when the request asks how to accomplish a concrete task in the Shopware admin.
tutorials.intro: Task-oriented recipes from the documentation — the answers to "how do I actually do X" rather than what a screen contains.

general.title: Shopware administration overview
general.description: Shopware administration orientation: first steps, feature overview, extension management, comparison with Shopify. Use when the request asks what the Shopware admin offers or how to get started.
general.intro: Orientation for the administration as a whole: where things live, what the editions include, and how to install extensions.
